|---|---|---:|---|

| February | 25-02 | $150 or $190 | [other/feb-draft.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-C-G/other/feb-draft.txt) lists a $150 draft; [other/feb-revision.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-C-G/other/feb-revision.txt) lists a $190 revision submitted with customer approval pending. |

**Total:** January and March sum to **$220**. Including February, the quarter totals **$370** if the $150 draft is the applicable amount, or **$410** if the $190 revision was approved. The evidence does not establish either February amount as final, so a single definitive quarter total is not justified.

The agreement says invoice revisions require customer approval ([current/agreement.txt](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-C-G/current/agreement.txt)). **Decision needed:** confirm whether the customer approved the February revision; until then, treat the February amount and all-in quarter total as unresolved.
